schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
schemes.summary: ₹6,000 a year for farmer families who own cultivable land, paid in three instalments of ₹2,000 straight into the bank account.
schemes.summary_hi: ज़मीन वाले किसान परिवारों को साल में ₹6,000, ₹2,000 की तीन किस्तों में सीधे बैंक खाते में।
benefits: ₹6,000 per year for each eligible farmer family
Paid in three equal instalments of ₹2,000
Money is sent by Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the Aadhaar-seeded bank account
eligibility: Farmer family that owns cultivable land (name in the land records)
Bank account seeded with Aadhaar
exclusions: Families where a member paid income tax in the last assessment year
Professionals such as doctors, engineers, lawyers and chartered accountants
Retired pensioners getting ₹10,000 or more per month (except MTS / Class IV / Group D)
Serving or retired government officers and employees (except MTS / Class IV / Group D)
Present or former holders of constitutional posts, ministers, MPs and MLAs

criteria.label: No income tax paid in the last assessment year
Not a government employee (except MTS / Group D)

online: Register on the PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) under 'New Farmer Registration' using Aadhaar
offline: Apply through your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or the state agriculture / revenue office
The state government verifies your land and bank details and uploads them; payment starts after the check

faqs.q: How much money will I get?
faqs.a: ₹6,000 a year, in three instalments of ₹2,000 each.

faqs.q: Who checks if I am eligible?
faqs.a: The state government verifies your details and uploads them to the portal. The system then checks your Aadhaar and bank account before paying.

sources.title: PIB: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi Scheme
PIB: PM-KISAN completes one year (exclusion criteria)

notes: The exclusion list comes from a February 2020 PIB release. The PM-KISAN portal could not be read when this was checked.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
schemes.summary: A ₹3,000 monthly pension from age 60 for small and marginal farmers who join between 18 and 40 and pay a small monthly amount.
schemes.summary_hi: छोटे और सीमांत किसानों के लिए 60 साल के बाद ₹3,000 महीना पेंशन; 18 से 40 साल की उम्र में जुड़कर थोड़ा-थोड़ा जमा करें।
benefits: Assured minimum pension of ₹3,000 per month after age 60
The farmer pays ₹55 to ₹200 a month depending on entry age; the Centre adds the same amount
If the farmer dies after the pension starts, the spouse gets 50% (₹1,500 a month)
LIC manages the pension fund
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers with cultivable land up to 2 hectares
Entry age 18 to 40 years
Name in the land records as on 1 August 2019

criteria.label: Bank account for the monthly contribution

online: Enrol on the PM-KMY portal (pmkmy.gov.in)
offline: Enrol at your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC)

faqs.q: How much do I have to pay?
faqs.a: Between ₹55 and ₹200 a month, depending on your age when you join. The government adds an equal amount.

sources.title: PIB: Five successful years of PM-KMY
PIB backgrounder: Securing Farmers' Future with Dignity

notes: The full exclusion list was not on the pages checked. The PM-KMY portal could not be read.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
schemes.summary: Crop insurance at a low premium: farmers pay at most 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi and 5% for commercial or horticulture crops. The government pays the rest.
schemes.summary_hi: कम प्रीमियम पर फसल बीमा: किसान खरीफ़ पर अधिकतम 2%, रबी पर 1.5% और बागवानी/व्यावसायिक फसलों पर 5% देता है, बाकी सरकार देती है।
benefits: Farmer's premium is capped at 2% of the sum insured for Kharif crops
Capped at 1.5% for Rabi crops and 5% for commercial / horticulture crops
The rest of the premium is shared by the Centre and states (50:50; 90:10 in North-Eastern and Himalayan states)
Some states pay the farmer's share as well
eligibility: Farmers growing crops that the state has notified for their area and season

online: Apply on the PMFBY portal (pmfby.gov.in) before the season's cut-off date
offline: Apply through your bank branch, a Common Service Centre (CSC) or the insurance company's agent

sources.title: PIB: PMFBY provides crop insurance at highly subsidised premium rates
PIB: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana turns nine

deadline.text: Each state sets season-wise cut-off dates

notes: Premium caps are confirmed by PIB. The detailed eligibility and document list come from the PMFBY portal, which could not be read; confirm with your bank or the portal.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card with Modified Interest Subvention Scheme
schemes.name_hi: किसान क्रेडिट कार्ड (ब्याज छूट योजना के साथ)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
schemes.summary: Short-term farm loans through a Kisan Credit Card at 7% interest. Repay on time and the effective rate falls to 4%.
schemes.summary_hi: किसान क्रेडिट कार्ड से 7% ब्याज पर खेती का छोटा कर्ज़; समय पर चुकाने पर ब्याज सिर्फ़ 4%।
benefits: Concessional interest of 7% a year on short-term KCC loans
Extra 3% Prompt Repayment Incentive if you repay on time, so the effective rate becomes 4%
Loan limit under the scheme was ₹3 lakh; Budget 2025-26 raised it to ₹5 lakh
Collateral-free credit up to ₹2 lakh per borrower
eligibility: Farmers taking short-term crop and allied-activity loans from a bank

offline: Apply at any commercial bank, regional rural bank or cooperative bank branch

faqs.q: What interest will I really pay?
faqs.a: 7% a year, which drops to 4% if you repay on time.

sources.title: PIB: Cabinet approves continuation of MISS for FY 2025-26
PIB backgrounder: Kisan Credit Card, fuelling growth in agriculture

notes: PIB releases give both ₹3 lakh and ₹5 lakh as the loan limit. Confirm the current limit with your bank.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
schemes.name_hi: आयुष्मान भारत प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare (National Health Authority)
schemes.summary: Free, cashless hospital treatment up to ₹5 lakh per family per year at empanelled hospitals for eligible families.
schemes.summary_hi: योग्य परिवारों को सूचीबद्ध अस्पतालों में हर साल ₹5 लाख तक का मुफ़्त, कैशलेस इलाज।
benefits: Health cover up to ₹5 lakh per family per year
Covers secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation
Cashless and paperless at empanelled government and private hospitals
eligibility: Families identified from the SECC 2011 data: deprivation criteria in villages and occupation criteria in towns
Some groups are included automatically, such as households without shelter, destitute people, manual scavenger families, primitive tribal groups and legally released bonded labourers
Many states have added more families beyond the SECC list

criteria.label: Family is in the PM-JAY beneficiary list

online: Check whether your family is listed and make an Ayushman card on beneficiary.nha.gov.in or the Ayushman app
offline: Visit an empanelled hospital (ask for the Ayushman Mitra) or a Common Service Centre (CSC)

faqs.q: Do I have to pay at the hospital?
faqs.a: No. Treatment is cashless and paperless at empanelled hospitals, up to ₹5 lakh per family per year.

sources.title: PIB: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
PIB: Salient features of AB-PMJAY

schemes.name: Ayushman Vay Vandana (AB PM-JAY for senior citizens aged 70+)
schemes.name_hi: आयुष्मान वय वंदना (70+ बुज़ुर्गों के लिए)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare (National Health Authority)
schemes.summary: Free treatment cover of up to ₹5 lakh a year for every person aged 70 or above, whatever their income.
schemes.summary_hi: 70 साल या उससे ज़्यादा उम्र के हर व्यक्ति को, आय कुछ भी हो, साल में ₹5 लाख तक का मुफ़्त इलाज।
benefits: Up to ₹5 lakh of free treatment per year
If the family is already under AB PM-JAY, the senior gets an extra top-up of up to ₹5 lakh a year for themselves
Large network of empanelled government and private hospitals
eligibility: Age 70 years or above
No income limit
exclusions: People already covered by CGHS, ECHS or Ayushman CAPF must choose either their current scheme or AB PM-JAY

online: Register on the Ayushman app or beneficiary.nha.gov.in with Aadhaar
offline: Visit a nearby empanelled hospital

faqs.q: Is there an income limit?
faqs.a: No. Everyone aged 70 or above can get the card.

sources.title: PIB: Ayushman Vay Vandana enrolment touches 10 lakh
PIB: Update on Ayushman Bharat Vay Vandana Cards

schemes.name: Janani Suraksha Yojana
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare (National Health Mission)
schemes.summary: Cash help for pregnant women who give birth in a government or accredited hospital, to make childbirth safer.
schemes.summary_hi: सरकारी या मान्यता प्राप्त अस्पताल में प्रसव कराने वाली गर्भवती महिलाओं को नकद मदद, ताकि प्रसव सुरक्षित हो।
benefits: Low Performing States, rural area: ₹1,400 to the mother (plus ₹600 to the ASHA)
Low Performing States, urban area: ₹1,000 to the mother (plus ₹400 to the ASHA)
High Performing States, rural area: ₹700 to the mother (plus ₹600 to the ASHA)
High Performing States, urban area: ₹600 to the mother (plus ₹400 to the ASHA)
eligibility: Low Performing States (UP, Uttarakhand, Bihar, Jharkhand, MP, Chhattisgarh, Assam, Rajasthan, Odisha, J&K): all pregnant women who deliver in a government health centre
All other states: BPL, SC and ST women who deliver in a government health centre
All states: BPL, SC and ST women who deliver in an accredited private hospital

criteria.label: Pregnant, delivering in a government or accredited hospital

offline: Register your pregnancy with your ASHA worker or the nearest government health centre
Deliver at a government health centre or an accredited private hospital

sources.title: National Health Mission: Janani Suraksha Yojana

notes: The official page does not list documents. Ask your ASHA worker what to bring.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Women & Child Development
schemes.summary: ₹5,000 for the first child, and ₹6,000 for a second child if it is a girl, paid to the mother's bank or post office account.
schemes.summary_hi: पहले बच्चे पर ₹5,000, और दूसरी संतान बेटी हो तो ₹6,000, सीधे माँ के बैंक या डाकघर खाते में।
benefits: ₹5,000 in two instalments for the first living child
₹6,000 in one instalment after birth if the second child is a girl
Paid by DBT to the mother's bank or post office account
With JSY benefits, a mother gets about ₹6,000 on average for the first child
eligibility: Pregnant women and breastfeeding mothers, for the first living child
For the second child, only if the child is a girl

criteria.label: Pregnant or breastfeeding (first child, or second child who is a girl)

online: Register on the PMMVY portal (pmmvy.wcd.gov.in)
offline: Register through your Anganwadi worker or ASHA

sources.title: PIB: PMMVY strengthens maternal health and early childhood care
PIB: Cash incentive of ₹5,000 under PMMVY

notes: Benefit amounts are confirmed by PIB (2026). The PMMVY portal, which lists who else qualifies and the documents, could not be read.

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (Sukanya Samriddhi Account)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance (Department of Posts runs the accounts)
schemes.summary: A government savings account for a girl below 10, with a tax benefit. Deposit between ₹250 and ₹1.5 lakh a year.
schemes.summary_hi: 10 साल से छोटी बेटी के लिए सरकारी बचत खाता, टैक्स छूट के साथ; साल में ₹250 से ₹1.5 लाख तक जमा करें।
benefits: Government-backed savings account for the girl child
Tax benefit under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act
Minimum ₹250 a year (deposits in multiples of ₹50); maximum ₹1.5 lakh a year
Deposits can be made for up to 15 years from opening
Interest rate is set by the government each quarter; ask the post office for the current rate
eligibility: Girl child below 10 years of age, resident in India
Account is opened by a parent or legal guardian
One account per girl and up to two per family (exception for twins or triplets)

criteria.label: Below 10 years when the account is opened

offline: Open the account at any post office or an authorised bank branch

faqs.q: What if I deposit more than ₹1.5 lakh in a year?
faqs.a: The extra amount earns no interest and is returned.

sources.title: PIB: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
PIB: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana, a decade of transforming lives

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas
schemes.summary: A free LPG connection for adult women of poor households: no deposit, and the first refill and the stove are free.
schemes.summary_hi: ग़रीब परिवार की वयस्क महिला को मुफ़्त LPG कनेक्शन: कोई जमा राशि नहीं, पहला सिलेंडर और चूल्हा भी मुफ़्त।
benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection with no installation charge
First refill and stove (hotplate) are free
Applying online yourself is free; a CSC charges ₹20
eligibility: Adult woman (18 years or above) from a poor household

From an SC or ST household, PMAY-Gramin, Most Backward Classes, Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY), tea and ex-tea garden tribes, forest dwellers, island or river-island dwellers, SECC (AHL TIN) households, or any poor household as per the 14-point deprivation declaration
No other LPG connection in the same household
exclusions: Households with a piped gas (PNG) connection
Men and minors cannot apply
A second connection in the same family under another name

criteria.label: Poor household (one of the listed groups or deprivation declaration)

documents: Aadhaar of all adult family members

online: Apply on pmuy.gov.in and choose IndianOil, Bharat Gas or HP Gas
offline: Submit the form at your nearest LPG distributor
The distributor does a biometric Aadhaar check and inspects your home before the connection is released

faqs.q: Do I have to pay anything?
faqs.a: No charge for a new connection (any state stamp fee is extra). The stove and first refill are free. Applying through a CSC costs ₹20.

faqs.q: My refill subsidy has not come. What should I do?
faqs.a: Check that your bank account is linked to Aadhaar and enabled for DBT, then contact your distributor or the helpline.

sources.title: PMUY: About the scheme
PMUY: Frequently asked questions

notes: The official site shows two different amounts for the connection cost covered (₹1,600 or ₹2,050 for a 14.2 kg cylinder), so Sarthi does not show a figure.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
schemes.name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Rural Development (National Social Assistance Programme)
schemes.summary: A monthly pension for people aged 60 or above from BPL households: ₹200 a month from the Centre (₹500 at 80+), plus a state top-up.
schemes.summary_hi: BPL परिवारों के 60+ उम्र के लोगों को हर महीने पेंशन: केंद्र से ₹200 (80+ पर ₹500), ऊपर से राज्य का हिस्सा।
benefits: Central share of ₹200 a month for age 60 to 79
₹500 a month for age 80 and above
States add their own amount, so the pension you get depends on your state
Paid monthly (some states pay every quarter) to a bank or post office account
eligibility: Age 60 years or above
Household is below the poverty line (BPL) as per government criteria
More than one person in the same BPL family can get it
exclusions: The pension stops after the person's death; it does not pass to a nominee
Joint bank accounts with family members are not allowed for the pension

offline: Apply through your Gram Panchayat (village) or Municipality (town), or the block / district social welfare office
The state department checks and sanctions the pension

faqs.q: Is there a last date?
faqs.a: No. Identifying eligible people is a continuous process.

faqs.q: Can two people in the same family get it?
faqs.a: Yes. Everyone aged 60+ in a BPL family can get it.

sources.title: NSAP: About the programme
NSAP: Frequently asked questions

notes: The NSAP pages do not list documents; the list above is the usual set. Ask your Gram Panchayat or welfare office.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
schemes.name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय विधवा पेंशन योजना
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Rural Development (National Social Assistance Programme)
schemes.summary: A monthly pension for widows aged 40 or above from BPL households, with a central share and a state top-up.
schemes.summary_hi: BPL परिवारों की 40+ उम्र की विधवा महिलाओं को हर महीने पेंशन, केंद्र और राज्य दोनों का हिस्सा।
benefits: Monthly pension from the Centre, plus an amount added by the state
NSAP 'About' page: ₹300 a month for age 40 to 79 and ₹500 a month at 80+
eligibility: Widow aged 40 years or above
Household is below the poverty line (BPL)

offline: Apply through your Gram Panchayat or Municipality, or the block / district social welfare office

sources.title: NSAP: About the programme
NSAP: Frequently asked questions

notes: NSAP pages conflict: the FAQ says ₹200 a month for widows aged 40 to 59, while the 'About' page says ₹300 (40 to 79) and ₹500 (80+). Confirm the amount with your state welfare office.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme
schemes.name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय दिव्यांग पेंशन योजना
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Rural Development (National Social Assistance Programme)
schemes.summary: A monthly pension for people aged 18 or above with severe or multiple disabilities from BPL households, with a state top-up.
schemes.summary_hi: BPL परिवारों के गंभीर या बहु-दिव्यांगता वाले 18+ उम्र के लोगों को हर महीने पेंशन, राज्य का हिस्सा भी।
benefits: Monthly pension from the Centre, plus an amount added by the state
NSAP 'About' page: ₹300 a month for age 18 to 79 and ₹500 a month at 80+
eligibility: Age 18 years or above
Severe or multiple disabilities
Household is below the poverty line (BPL)

offline: Apply through your Gram Panchayat or Municipality, or the block / district social welfare office

sources.title: NSAP: About the programme
NSAP: Frequently asked questions

notes: NSAP pages conflict: the FAQ says ₹200 a month for age 18 to 59, the 'About' page says ₹300 (18 to 79) and ₹500 (80+).
The pages say 'severe or multiple disabilities' without a percentage; the 80% rule used for matching must be confirmed.

schemes.name: National Family Benefit Scheme
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Rural Development (National Social Assistance Programme)
schemes.summary: One-time money for a BPL family when its main earning member dies.
schemes.summary_hi: BPL परिवार के मुख्य कमाने वाले सदस्य की मृत्यु होने पर परिवार को एक बार की आर्थिक मदद।
benefits: One-time lump-sum assistance; the NSAP 'About' page says ₹20,000
eligibility: Death of the household's primary breadwinner (man or woman), whose earnings were a large part of the family income
The breadwinner was aged between 18 and 64 (FAQ) at death
Household is below the poverty line (BPL)
Paid to the surviving member who, after local enquiry, is found to be the head of the household

criteria.label: BPL household that lost its main earner

offline: Apply to the state social welfare department through your Gram Panchayat, Municipality or block office

sources.title: NSAP: About the programme
NSAP: Frequently asked questions

notes: NSAP pages conflict: the FAQ says ₹10,000 and age 18 to 64; the 'About' page says ₹20,000 and age 18 to 59. Confirm with your state welfare office.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance (Department of Financial Services)
schemes.summary: Life insurance of ₹2 lakh for ₹436 a year, for anyone aged 18 to 50 with a bank account.
schemes.summary_hi: 18 से 50 साल के बैंक खाते वाले किसी भी व्यक्ति के लिए ₹436 सालाना में ₹2 लाख का जीवन बीमा।
benefits: ₹2 lakh paid to the family on death from any cause
Premium of ₹436 a year, auto-debited from your bank account
Cover runs from 1 June to 31 May and is renewed every year
eligibility: Age 18 to 50 years
Has a bank account and agrees to auto-debit

online: Join through your bank's internet or mobile banking, where available
offline: Fill the enrolment form at your bank branch and give consent for auto-debit

sources.title: Department of Financial Services: PMJJBY

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance (Department of Financial Services)
schemes.summary: Accident insurance of ₹2 lakh for just ₹20 a year, for anyone aged 18 to 70 with a bank account.
schemes.summary_hi: 18 से 70 साल के बैंक खाते वाले किसी भी व्यक्ति के लिए सिर्फ़ ₹20 सालाना में ₹2 लाख का दुर्घटना बीमा।
benefits: ₹2 lakh on accidental death or permanent total disability
₹1 lakh on permanent partial disability
Premium of ₹20 a year, auto-debited from your bank account
Cover runs from 1 June to 31 May and is renewed every year
eligibility: Age 18 to 70 years
Has a bank account and agrees to auto-debit

online: Join through your bank's internet or mobile banking, where available
offline: Fill the enrolment form at your bank branch and give consent for auto-debit

sources.title: Department of Financial Services: PMSBY

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance (administered by PFRDA)
schemes.summary: A guaranteed pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 a month after age 60, for people who join between 18 and 40 and do not pay income tax.
schemes.summary_hi: 60 साल के बाद ₹1,000 से ₹5,000 महीने की पक्की पेंशन; 18 से 40 साल में जुड़ें, आयकर दाता न हों।
benefits: Guaranteed minimum pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000 or ₹5,000 a month after age 60, as you choose
After your death the spouse gets the same pension
After both die, the nominee gets the saved pension amount
eligibility: Indian citizen aged 18 to 40
Savings account in a bank or post office
exclusions: Anyone who is or has been an income tax payer cannot join (from 1 October 2022)

criteria.label: Bank or post office savings account

online: Register online through eAPY (link on the PFRDA website)
offline: Fill the APY registration form at your bank branch or post office

sources.title: PFRDA: Atal Pension Yojana

notes: The monthly contribution depends on your age and chosen pension; ask your bank for the chart.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Labour & Employment
schemes.summary: A ₹3,000 monthly pension after 60 for unorganised workers earning up to ₹15,000 a month who join between 18 and 40.
schemes.summary_hi: ₹15,000 महीने तक कमाने वाले असंगठित मज़दूरों के लिए 60 साल के बाद ₹3,000 महीना पेंशन; 18 से 40 साल में जुड़ें।
benefits: Assured pension of ₹3,000 a month after age 60
The government puts in the same amount as you (for example ₹55 + ₹55 at age 18, ₹200 + ₹200 at age 40)
If you die, your spouse gets a family pension of 50%
eligibility: Unorganised worker such as a home-based worker, street vendor, mid-day meal worker, head loader, brick kiln worker or similar
Entry age 18 to 40 years
Monthly income of ₹15,000 or less
exclusions: Members of EPFO, ESIC or NPS
Income tax payers

criteria.label: Not in EPFO, ESIC or NPS

online: Self-enrol on maandhan.in
offline: Visit a Common Service Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar and your savings or Jan Dhan account details
Pay the first contribution in cash at the CSC; later contributions are auto-debited

faqs.q: Do I need income or age proof?
faqs.a: No separate proof is needed. Aadhaar and a self-declaration are enough.

faqs.q: What if I die before the pension starts?
faqs.a: Your spouse can continue paying and get the pension, or take back the contributions with interest.

sources.title: Maandhan portal (Ministry of Labour & Employment)
Maandhan: PM-SYM FAQ

schemes.name: Assistance to Persons with Disabilities for Purchase / Fitting of Aids and Appliances (ADIP)
schemes.name_hi: सहायक यंत्र/उपकरण खरीद के लिए दिव्यांगजन सहायता योजना (एडिप)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities)
schemes.summary: Free or subsidised aids and assistive devices (such as tricycles, hearing aids and artificial limbs) for persons with 40% or more disability.
schemes.summary_hi: 40% या ज़्यादा दिव्यांगता वाले लोगों को मुफ़्त या सस्ते सहायक उपकरण, जैसे ट्राइसाइकिल, सुनने की मशीन, कृत्रिम अंग।
benefits: Aids costing up to ₹15,000: full cost covered
Aids costing ₹15,001 to ₹30,000: help of up to ₹15,000
Corrective surgery may be arranged first where needed
eligibility: Indian citizen of any age
UDID card (or enrolment number) with a disability certificate of at least 40%
Own monthly income (or parents' income for dependants) of ₹30,000 or less
Has not received an aid for the same purpose in the last 3 years (1 year for children's customised items)

online: Apply on the ARJUN portal (adip.depwd.gov.in)
offline: Attend an assessment camp or visit an implementing agency such as ALIMCO, a Composite Regional Centre or the District Disability Rehabilitation Centre

faqs.q: I have no income certificate. Can I still apply?
faqs.a: Yes. A BPL card, MGNREGA card, disability pension card, or a certificate from an MP, MLA, councillor or Gram Pradhan is accepted; otherwise a self-certification or affidavit.

sources.title: DEPwD: ADIP Scheme
DEPwD: Revised ADIP scheme guidelines (OM dated 26.09.2024)

notes: The revised scheme was approved up to 31 March 2026. Its continuation after that date was not found on the official pages; confirm with DEPwD.

schemes.name: Post Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students
schemes.name_hi: अनुसूचित जाति के छात्रों के लिए पोस्ट मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
schemes.summary: Covers college or school fees and gives an allowance for SC students studying after Class 10, if parents earn up to ₹2.5 lakh a year.
schemes.summary_hi: 10वीं के बाद पढ़ने वाले SC छात्रों की फ़ीस और भत्ता, अगर माता-पिता की आय ₹2.5 लाख सालाना तक है।
benefits: Compulsory non-refundable fees (such as tuition fees fixed by state fee committees) are paid
Academic allowance for the full course
Extra allowance for students with disabilities
eligibility: Indian national belonging to a Scheduled Caste
Parents' or guardian's income up to ₹2.5 lakh a year
Studying at post-matric level (Class 11 onwards, including college and professional courses)

criteria.label: Family income up to ₹2.5 lakh a year

online: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal or your state's scholarship portal (Punjab: punjabscholarships.gov.in)
Your institute verifies the application, then the state approves it

faqs.q: Is the income limit ₹8 lakh?
faqs.a: No. ₹8 lakh is the EWS limit for reservation. For this scholarship the limit is ₹2.5 lakh a year.

sources.title: PIB: Year-End Review 2025, Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
PIB: Income limit for Post-Matric Scholarship

deadline.text: Application window opens each academic year on the scholarship portal

notes: The document list is the usual set; your state portal may ask for more.

schemes.name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Education
schemes.summary: ₹12,000 a year from Class 9 to 12 for bright students of government schools whose parents earn up to ₹3.5 lakh a year.
schemes.summary_hi: सरकारी स्कूलों के होनहार छात्रों को 9वीं से 12वीं तक ₹12,000 सालाना, अगर माता-पिता की आय ₹3.5 लाख तक है।
benefits: ₹12,000 per year per student
One lakh new scholarships every year in Class 9, renewed in Classes 10 to 12
eligibility: Student of a state government, government-aided or local body school
Parents' income from all sources up to ₹3.5 lakh a year
At least 55% marks in Class 7 (5% relaxation for SC / ST) to sit the state selection test

criteria.label: Family income up to ₹3.5 lakh a year
Studying in Class 9 to 12 in a government school

online: Clear your state's NMMS selection test, then apply (fresh or renewal) on the National Scholarship Portal

sources.title: PIB: NMMSS 2025-26 last date extended to 30 September 2025
PIB: NMMSS 2024-25 applications

deadline.text: Yearly on the National Scholarship Portal (2025-26 closed on 30 Sep 2025)

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana – Gramin
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
schemes.summary: Money to build a pucca house for homeless and kutcha-house families in villages: ₹1.20 lakh in plains and ₹1.30 lakh in hilly and North-Eastern states.
schemes.summary_hi: गाँव के बेघर और कच्चे मकान वाले परिवारों को पक्का घर बनाने के लिए ₹1.20 लाख (मैदान) या ₹1.30 लाख (पहाड़ी व पूर्वोत्तर राज्य)।
benefits: ₹1.20 lakh per house in plain areas
₹1.30 lakh in North-Eastern and hill states (including J&K and Ladakh), difficult areas and IAP districts
90 to 95 days of unskilled wages through MGNREGS for building the house
₹12,000 for a toilet through other schemes
eligibility: Houseless families, and families living in zero, one or two rooms with kutcha walls and kutcha roof
Selected from the SECC 2011 and Awaas+ 2018 survey data, after applying exclusion criteria

offline: Beneficiaries are picked from the SECC / Awaas+ lists and approved by the Gram Sabha
Ask your Gram Panchayat or Block office whether your family is on the list

sources.title: PIB: Funds for construction of houses under PMAY-G
PIB: Cabinet approves PMAY-G for FY 2024-25 to 2028-29

notes: The PMAY-G portal could not be read; facts come from PIB releases (latest seen: December 2024).

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban 2.0
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs
schemes.summary: Help for urban families earning up to ₹9 lakh a year to build, buy or rent a house: up to ₹2.5 lakh per house, or a home-loan interest subsidy.
schemes.summary_hi: ₹9 लाख सालाना तक कमाने वाले शहरी परिवारों को घर बनाने, ख़रीदने या किराए के लिए मदद: प्रति घर ₹2.5 लाख तक या होम लोन पर ब्याज सब्सिडी।
benefits: Build your own house (BLC) or buy in a partnership project (AHP): central help of ₹1.5 lakh in most states (state adds at least ₹1 lakh); ₹2.25 lakh in North-East, Himachal, Uttarakhand, J&K, Puducherry and Delhi; ₹2.5 lakh in other UTs
Home-loan Interest Subsidy (ISS): up to ₹1.80 lakh per house
Affordable Rental Housing (ARH) for those who need a rented home
Central help for building is paid by DBT in three instalments (40:40:20) as construction progresses
eligibility: Urban family (husband, wife, unmarried children): EWS up to ₹3 lakh, LIG ₹3 to 6 lakh, MIG ₹6 to 9 lakh income a year
No pucca house in the name of any family member anywhere in India
Has not taken a housing scheme benefit in the last 20 years
House in the name of the woman head, or jointly with the man
Preference for widows, single women, persons with disabilities, senior citizens, transgender persons, SC / ST and minorities
exclusions: Families who got a housing scheme benefit in the last 20 years
Only one vertical (BLC, AHP, ARH or ISS) can be used

criteria.label: Lives in a town or city
Family income up to ₹9 lakh a year
No pucca house anywhere in India

online: Check eligibility and apply on the PMAY-U 2.0 portal (pmaymis.gov.in)
offline: Apply at a Common Service Centre (CSC) or your Urban Local Body / Municipality office

faqs.q: How long will the scheme run?
faqs.a: Five years, from 1 September 2024 to 2029.

faqs.q: Whose name will the house be in?
faqs.a: The woman head of the family, or jointly with the man head, with a few exceptions.

sources.title: PMAY-U 2.0: About the scheme
PMAY-U 2.0: FAQ
PMAY-U 2.0 Scheme Guidelines (September 2024)

notes: Older pages on pmay-urban.gov.in still describe PMAY-U 1.0; the figures above are from the 2.0 portal and guidelines.

schemes.name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
schemes.name_hi: पीएम सूर्य घर: मुफ़्त बिजली योजना
schemes.ministry: Ministry of New & Renewable Energy
schemes.summary: Subsidy for rooftop solar on your house: ₹30,000 for 1 kW, ₹60,000 for 2 kW and ₹78,000 for 3 kW or more.
schemes.summary_hi: घर की छत पर सोलर लगाने के लिए सब्सिडी: 1 kW पर ₹30,000, 2 kW पर ₹60,000 और 3 kW या ज़्यादा पर ₹78,000।
benefits: ₹30,000 subsidy for a 1 kW system, ₹60,000 for 2 kW and ₹78,000 for 3 kW or more (cap)
Subsidy is credited to your bank account
Collateral-free bank loans are available for the rest of the cost
eligibility: Indian citizen
Owns a house with a roof suitable for solar panels
Has a valid electricity connection
Has not taken any other solar subsidy

criteria.label: Owns a house with a suitable roof

online: Register on the national portal pmsuryaghar.gov.in and choose a registered vendor
After installation and inspection, apply for the subsidy on the portal

faqs.q: What size should I install?
faqs.a: About 1 to 2 kW if you use up to 150 units a month, 2 to 3 kW for 150 to 300 units, and more than 3 kW above 300 units.

sources.title: PIB: Cabinet approves PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
PIB: PM Surya Ghar, India's solar revolution

notes: Loan interest rates change; check the portal or your bank for the current rate.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution
schemes.summary: Free ration for NFSA ration card holders: 35 kg a month for Antyodaya families and 5 kg per person a month for priority households.
schemes.summary_hi: NFSA राशन कार्ड वालों को मुफ़्त अनाज: अंत्योदय परिवार को 35 किलो महीना और प्राथमिक परिवार को हर सदस्य पर 5 किलो महीना।
benefits: 35 kg of foodgrains a month per Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) household, free
5 kg of foodgrains per person a month for Priority Households (PHH), free
Free for five years from 1 January 2024
eligibility: Holds an AAY or Priority Household ration card under the National Food Security Act

criteria.label: AAY or Priority Household ration card

offline: If you have no ration card, apply to your state food and civil supplies department
Collect your grain from your fair price (ration) shop

sources.title: PIB: Free foodgrains for 81.35 crore beneficiaries for five years
PIB: Department of Food & Public Distribution, Year End Review 2025

notes: 1967 is the general helpline of the Department of Food & Public Distribution; states also run their own ration helplines.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance (Department of Financial Services)
schemes.summary: Collateral-free business loans up to ₹20 lakh for small and micro enterprises, in four stages: Shishu, Kishor, Tarun and Tarun Plus.
schemes.summary_hi: छोटे और सूक्ष्म कारोबार के लिए बिना गारंटी ₹20 लाख तक का लोन, चार श्रेणियों में: शिशु, किशोर, तरुण और तरुण प्लस।
benefits: Shishu: loans up to ₹50,000
Kishor: above ₹50,000 and up to ₹5 lakh
Tarun: above ₹5 lakh and up to ₹10 lakh
Tarun Plus: ₹10 lakh to ₹20 lakh, for those who took and repaid a Tarun loan
No collateral needed; loans are guaranteed by the Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units
eligibility: Small and micro entrepreneurs starting or growing an income-generating business

criteria.label: Running or starting a small business

offline: Apply at a bank, regional rural bank, small finance bank, micro-finance institution or NBFC

faqs.q: Can I get Tarun Plus directly?
faqs.a: No. Tarun Plus is only for borrowers who have taken and repaid a Tarun loan.

sources.title: PIB: PM Mudra Yojana provides collateral-free loans up to ₹20 lakh
PIB: PMMY completes 11 years

notes: The MUDRA website could not be read; facts come from PIB releases (2026).

schemes.name: Stand-Up India
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance (Department of Financial Services); portal run by SIDBI
schemes.summary: Bank loans of ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore for SC / ST and women entrepreneurs starting their first enterprise.
schemes.summary_hi: SC/ST और महिला उद्यमियों को पहला कारोबार शुरू करने के लिए ₹10 लाख से ₹1 करोड़ तक का बैंक लोन।
benefits: Composite loan (term loan + working capital) between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore
Covers up to 85% of the project cost
Interest not more than the bank's base rate (MCLR) + 3% + tenor premium
Repay over up to 7 years, with up to 18 months' moratorium
Working capital up to ₹10 lakh as an overdraft with a RuPay debit card
eligibility: SC / ST and/or woman entrepreneur, above 18 years
Greenfield (first-time) enterprise in manufacturing, services, agri-allied activities or trading
For companies or firms: at least 51% shareholding and control held by an SC / ST or woman entrepreneur
Not a defaulter to any bank or financial institution
Brings at least 10% of the project cost as own contribution
exclusions: Crop loans and land improvement such as canals, irrigation and wells
Borrowers in default to a bank or financial institution

online: Register free on standupmitra.in and apply to the bank you choose
If you need help, choose 'Trainee Borrower' to get handholding first
offline: Apply directly at any scheduled commercial bank branch, or use the portal through a CSC

faqs.q: Is registration on the portal free?
faqs.a: Yes. Registration is free; training agencies charge their own fees.

faqs.q: What if I need less than ₹10 lakh?
faqs.a: Banks lend smaller amounts under other schemes, such as MUDRA loans.

sources.title: Stand-Up India: Scheme features
Stand-Up India: FAQs

notes: Open to SC / ST entrepreneurs of any gender and to women of any category.

schemes.name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (run by KVIC)
schemes.summary: A bank loan with 15% to 35% government subsidy to start a new small business: up to ₹50 lakh for manufacturing and ₹20 lakh for services.
schemes.summary_hi: नया छोटा कारोबार शुरू करने के लिए बैंक लोन पर 15% से 35% सरकारी सब्सिडी: निर्माण में ₹50 लाख और सेवा में ₹20 लाख तक।
benefits: Subsidy (margin money) for general category: 25% in rural areas, 15% in urban areas
Special categories (SC / ST, OBC, minorities, women, ex-servicemen, persons with disabilities, NE / hill / border areas): 35% rural, 25% urban
Maximum project cost: ₹50 lakh for manufacturing, ₹20 lakh for services
Own contribution: 10% for general category, 5% for special categories
Existing units can get a second loan for upgrading, with a 15% subsidy (20% in NE and hill states)
eligibility: Individuals above 18 years setting up a new unit
Special-category benefits for SC / ST, OBC, minorities, women, ex-servicemen, persons with disabilities and applicants from NE, hill and border areas

online: Apply on the PMEGP e-portal (kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal); the application goes to KVIC, KVIB or the District Industries Centre and then to the bank

sources.title: PIB: Empowering the grassroots economy (MSME note)
PIB: PMEGP subsidy and own contribution

notes: The PMEGP portal could not be read; the education rule for larger projects is not shown here. Check the portal.

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
schemes.summary: For traditional artisans in 18 trades: ID card, paid training, a ₹15,000 toolkit grant and collateral-free loans up to ₹3 lakh at 5% interest.
schemes.summary_hi: 18 पारंपरिक कारीगर कामों के लिए: पहचान पत्र, भत्ते के साथ ट्रेनिंग, ₹15,000 टूलकिट और 5% ब्याज पर ₹3 लाख तक बिना गारंटी लोन।
benefits: PM Vishwakarma certificate and ID card
Basic training of 5 to 7 days with a stipend of ₹500 a day; optional 15-day advanced training
₹15,000 toolkit incentive
Collateral-free loan of ₹1 lakh (18 months), then up to ₹2 lakh (30 months), at 5% interest
₹1 per digital transaction, up to 100 transactions a month
Marketing support: quality certification, branding and e-commerce linkage
eligibility: Artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools, self-employed, in one of 18 family-based trades

Trades: carpenter, boat maker, armourer, blacksmith, hammer and tool kit maker, locksmith, sculptor / stone breaker, goldsmith, potter, cobbler / footwear artisan, mason, basket / mat / broom maker / coir weaver, traditional doll and toy maker, barber, garland maker, washerman, tailor, fishing net maker
At least 18 years old and working in the trade on the date of registration
Only one member per family (husband, wife and unmarried children)
exclusions: Government employees and their family members
People with an unpaid PM SVANidhi or MUDRA loan (those who repaid can apply)
People with a PMEGP loan

criteria.label: Artisan in one of the 18 trades
No government employee in the family

online: Register on pmvishwakarma.gov.in
offline: Register at a Common Service Centre (CSC), an MSME-DFO or the District Industries Centre

faqs.q: I have no ration card. What do I do?
faqs.a: Give the Aadhaar cards of all family members instead.

faqs.q: I have no bank account.
faqs.a: The CSC will help you open one.

sources.title: PM Vishwakarma portal
PM Vishwakarma FAQ

notes: The portal's eligibility section bars loans under similar schemes in the past 5 years, while its FAQ bars only unpaid loans. Confirm if you had a past loan.

schemes.name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
schemes.name_hi: पीएम स्ट्रीट वेंडर्स आत्मनिर्भर निधि (पीएम स्वनिधि)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs
schemes.summary: Collateral-free working-capital loans for street vendors (₹15,000, then ₹25,000, then ₹50,000) with a 7% interest subsidy and cashback on digital payments.
schemes.summary_hi: रेहड़ी-पटरी वालों को बिना गारंटी कारोबारी लोन (₹15,000, फिर ₹25,000, फिर ₹50,000), 7% ब्याज सब्सिडी और डिजिटल भुगतान पर कैशबैक।
benefits: 1st loan up to ₹15,000 (repay in 12 months), 2nd up to ₹25,000 (18 months), 3rd up to ₹50,000 (36 months)
Interest subsidy of 7% a year, credited every quarter
Cashback of ₹1 per digital transaction, up to ₹100 a month (₹1,200 a year), plus up to ₹400 a year on wholesale digital purchases
UPI-linked RuPay credit card (₹10,000, rising to ₹30,000) after repaying the 2nd loan
No penalty for repaying early
eligibility: Street vendors vending in towns, cities, census towns and peri-urban areas
Certificate of Vending or ID card, or a Letter of Recommendation from the town vending committee / urban local body (Block Development Office in census towns and peri-urban areas)
Available in states and UTs that have notified rules under the Street Vendors Act, 2014
documents: Certificate of Vending / Vendor ID / Letter of Recommendation

online: Link your mobile number to Aadhaar
Apply on pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or the PM SVANidhi app (with your SRN if you were surveyed)
offline: Apply through a nearby Common Service Centre (CSC), your urban local body or a lender's branch

faqs.q: I was left out of the vendor survey. Can I apply?
faqs.a: Yes. Get a Letter of Recommendation from your urban local body or town vending committee, then apply.

faqs.q: Do I need collateral?
faqs.a: No. The loans are collateral-free.

sources.title: PM SVANidhi Scheme Guidelines (extended phase)
PM SVANidhi: Before you apply

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship
schemes.summary: Free short-term skill training and certification for people aged 15 to 59, booked through the Skill India Digital Hub.
schemes.summary_hi: 15 से 59 साल के लोगों के लिए मुफ़्त छोटी अवधि की स्किल ट्रेनिंग और सर्टिफ़िकेट, स्किल इंडिया डिजिटल हब से।
benefits: Short-term skill training aligned to national standards (NSQF), with on-the-job training where required
Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) to certify skills you already have
Boarding, lodging and transport support for women, persons with disabilities and candidates from special areas
eligibility: Age 15 to 59 years
Aadhaar-based registration on the Skill India Digital Hub

online: Register on the Skill India Digital Hub (skillindiadigital.gov.in) and pick a course and training centre
offline: Visit a PMKVY training centre near you

sources.title: PIB: Implementation of PMKVY 4.0
PIB: Cabinet approves continuation and restructuring of Skill India Programme

notes: Fee and reward rules for PMKVY 4.0 were not on the pages checked.

schemes.name: Old Age Pension (Punjab)
schemes.ministry: Department of Social Security and Women & Child Development, Punjab
schemes.summary: ₹1,500 a month for women aged 58+ and men aged 65+ in Punjab with family income up to ₹60,000 a year.
schemes.summary_hi: पंजाब में 58+ उम्र की महिलाओं और 65+ उम्र के पुरुषों को ₹1,500 महीना, अगर सालाना आय ₹60,000 तक है।
benefits: ₹1,500 per month
eligibility: Women aged 58 or above; men aged 65 or above
Total annual income from all sources up to ₹60,000
Land (husband and wife together) up to 2.5 acres of irrigated (nehri / chahi) land, or 5 acres of barani or waterlogged land, as per the Patwari report

offline: Get the form from the District Social Security Officer, CDPO, Sewa Kendra, SDM office, Anganwadi centre, Panchayat or BDPO office
The CDPO verifies the application within one month and the District Social Security Officer sanctions it

faqs.q: Which age proof is accepted?
faqs.a: Any one of: Aadhaar, voter card, voter list, matriculation certificate, or a birth certificate from the Registrar of Births and Deaths.

sources.title: Punjab SSWCD: Old Age Pension

schemes.name: Financial Assistance to Widows and Destitute Women (Punjab)
schemes.name_hi: विधवा और बेसहारा महिलाओं को आर्थिक सहायता (पंजाब)
schemes.ministry: Department of Social Security and Women & Child Development, Punjab
schemes.summary: ₹1,500 a month for widows and destitute women below 58, and unmarried women above 30, in Punjab with income up to ₹60,000 a year.
schemes.summary_hi: पंजाब में 58 साल से कम उम्र की विधवा/बेसहारा महिलाओं और 30 साल से ज़्यादा उम्र की अविवाहित महिलाओं को ₹1,500 महीना।
benefits: ₹1,500 per month
eligibility: Widows or destitute women below 58 years
Unmarried women above 30 years
Total annual income up to ₹60,000

criteria.label: Widow, destitute, or unmarried and above 30

offline: Get the form from the District Social Security Officer, CDPO, Sewa Kendra, SDM office, Anganwadi centre, Panchayat or BDPO office

sources.title: Punjab SSWCD: Financial Assistance to Widows and Destitute Women

notes: The husband's death certificate is needed only for widows.

schemes.name: Financial Assistance to Dependent Children (Punjab)
schemes.ministry: Department of Social Security and Women & Child Development, Punjab
schemes.summary: ₹1,500 a month for children below 21 in Punjab who lost a parent, or whose parents are absent or unable to work.
schemes.summary_hi: पंजाब में 21 साल से कम उम्र के उन बच्चों को ₹1,500 महीना जिनके माता या पिता नहीं रहे, घर से दूर रहते हैं या काम करने में असमर्थ हैं।
benefits: ₹1,500 per month
eligibility: Children below 21 years
Mother, father or both have died, or parents are regularly absent from home, or parents are physically or mentally unable to work
Total annual income up to ₹60,000

offline: Get the form from the District Social Security Officer, CDPO, Sewa Kendra, SDM office, Anganwadi centre, Panchayat or BDPO office

sources.title: Punjab SSWCD: Financial Assistance to Dependent Children

notes: A parent's death certificate is needed only if a parent has died.

schemes.name: Financial Assistance to Persons with Disabilities (Punjab)
schemes.ministry: Department of Social Security and Women & Child Development, Punjab
schemes.summary: ₹1,500 a month for persons in Punjab with 50% or more disability who cannot earn a living, with income up to ₹60,000 a year.
schemes.summary_hi: पंजाब में 50% या ज़्यादा दिव्यांगता वाले, कमाई न कर पाने वाले लोगों को ₹1,500 महीना, अगर आय ₹60,000 सालाना तक है।
benefits: ₹1,500 per month
eligibility: Blind, physically disabled, deaf and mute, or mentally disabled persons unable to earn a livelihood
Disability of 50% or more (mentally disabled persons are eligible whatever the percentage)
Income up to ₹60,000 a year
exclusions: Persons with less than 50% disability (except mental disability)

offline: Get a disability certificate from the SMO / Civil Surgeon
Get the form from the District Social Security Officer, CDPO, Sewa Kendra, SDM office, Anganwadi centre, Panchayat or BDPO office

sources.title: Punjab SSWCD: Financial Assistance to Persons with Disabilities

schemes.name: Mukh Mantri Sehat Yojana (Punjab)
schemes.ministry: State Health Agency, Department of Health & Family Welfare, Punjab
schemes.summary: Cashless treatment up to ₹10 lakh per family per year at empanelled hospitals for every resident of Punjab, with no income limit.
schemes.summary_hi: पंजाब के हर निवासी परिवार को सूचीबद्ध अस्पतालों में हर साल ₹10 लाख तक का कैशलेस इलाज, कोई आय सीमा नहीं।
benefits: Cashless treatment up to ₹10 lakh per family per year
At empanelled government and private hospitals
eligibility: All bona fide residents of Punjab, including government employees and pensioners
No income cap

offline: Visit your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with the ID documents of all family members
You get an SMS when registered; the Sehat card reaches the CSC in 2 to 3 weeks

sources.title: State Health Agency Punjab

notes: Earlier versions of this scheme covered ₹5 lakh for selected groups only; the ₹10 lakh cover for all residents is from the current State Health Agency homepage.

schemes.name: Ashirwad Scheme (Punjab)
schemes.ministry: Department of Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes, Punjab
schemes.summary: Money for poor Punjab families at the time of a daughter's marriage: SC, Christian, Backward Class and EWS girls, daughters of widows, and SC widows who remarry.
schemes.summary_hi: पंजाब के ग़रीब परिवारों को बेटी की शादी पर आर्थिक मदद: SC, ईसाई, पिछड़ा वर्ग और EWS की बेटियाँ, विधवाओं की बेटियाँ और दोबारा शादी करने वाली SC विधवाएँ।
benefits: One-time financial help (shagun) at the time of marriage, paid directly to the bank account
For up to two girls in a family
eligibility: Scheduled Caste or Christian girls, Backward Class girls, EWS girls, daughters of widows of any caste; also SC widows / divorcees at remarriage
Girl is 18 years or older
Parents or guardian are domiciled in Punjab
Family income within the limit set by the department

criteria.label: SC, Christian, Backward Class or EWS family (or daughter of a widow)

online: Register on the Ashirwad portal (ashirwad.punjab.gov.in)
offline: Ask the District Welfare Officer if you need help applying

faqs.q: When should I apply?
faqs.a: The department's norms say apply before the marriage or within 30 days after it.

sources.title: Punjab Welfare Department: Ashirwad (Shagun) scheme note
Punjab State DBT Portal: scheme list

deadline.text: Apply before the marriage or within 30 days after it

notes: The department's scheme note gives ₹15,000 and an income limit of ₹32,790 (norms from 2014). These have likely been revised since, so Sarthi does not show them. Confirm the current amount on the Ashirwad portal or with the District Welfare Officer.
